title: Wait for Solid Green During Robot Restart Cycle Before Physically Moving (Brakes Stay Locked)
summary: After restarting a robot/AGV, it goes through a cycle. Do not physically move it until the robot indicator reaches the source-described green state. If it is solid green and not on a label, you must wait until it turns green for movement readiness because the brakes stay locked until that condition.
when_to_use: Use when you have initiated a robot/AGV restart and you need to determine when it is safe to physically move it based on the indicator color/state and label presence behavior described in the source.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Observe the robot indicator color/state during the restart cycle and only physically move the robot when the source-described green readiness condition is met.
safety_notes: Do not attempt to move the robot while brakes are still locked; the source states brakes stay locked until the robot reaches the correct green readiness condition.
access_or_tools_needed: Visual access to the robot indicator/sign showing flashing blue / solid blue / solid green
Ability to observe whether the robot is on a label (source describes 'not on a label' vs label identification)

system_preconditions: A robot/AGV restart has been initiated (so the robot is in the restart cycle described by the source).

visual_references.description: Robot restart panel and restart-cycle indicator behavior (flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green) and the brake-lock / wait-until-green movement rule.

steps.title: Observe the robot indicator color/state through the restart cycle
steps.purpose: To confirm the robot is progressing through the restart-cycle states so you can apply the correct movement readiness rule.
steps.instruction: After initiating the restart, visually observe the robot indicator color/state as it cycles (the source describes flashing blue, solid blue, and solid green).
steps.expected_result: The robot indicator transitions through the source-described restart-cycle states (including flashing blue and then solid blue) as the robot reacquires label status.
steps.healthy_condition: Indicator behavior matches the source-described progression during restart (flashing blue when searching for/related to label acquisition, then solid blue after label pickup).
steps.failure_condition: The indicator does not progress as expected (e.g., it remains in a non-green state or does not reach the source-described green state).

actions.label: Watch indicator color/state
actions.exact_action: Observe the robot indicator color/state through the restart cycle.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the indicator does not reach the source-described green state, escalate for further troubleshooting.

steps.title: Wait until the robot reaches solid green
steps.purpose: To ensure the robot has completed the restart cycle stage described as reaching solid green before considering movement.
steps.instruction: Continue observing until the robot indicator reaches solid green.
steps.expected_result: The robot indicator is solid green.
steps.healthy_condition: Indicator is solid green (as described by the source) during/after the restart cycle.
steps.failure_condition: The robot does not become solid green.

actions.label: Confirm solid green
actions.exact_action: Wait until the indicator reaches solid green.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the indicator does not reach solid green/green as described, escalate for further troubleshooting.

steps.title: Do not move while brakes are locked; wait until it turns green for movement readiness (especially if solid green and not on a label)
steps.purpose: To prevent unsafe movement while brakes remain locked, using the source-described green readiness rule and label condition.
steps.instruction: Before physically moving the robot, verify the source-described condition: if the robot is solid green and not on a label, wait until it turns green (movement readiness). The source states you must wait because brakes stay locked.
steps.expected_result: You only proceed to physical movement after the robot turns green for readiness (not merely solid green when not on a label).
steps.healthy_condition: Robot is in the source-described movement-ready green state (the source distinguishes 'solid green' vs 'turns green' readiness) and you have not moved it while brakes were locked.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt to move the robot while brakes are still locked (e.g., moving when it is solid green but not on a label, or before it turns green readiness).

actions.label: Check label presence and readiness green state
actions.exact_action: If it's solid green and not on a label, wait till it turns green for you to move it because the brakes stay locked.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not move the robot while brakes are still locked.
If the robot does not reach the source-described 'turns green' readiness condition, escalate for further troubleshooting.

steps.title: Proceed with moving the robot only after the source-described green readiness condition is met
steps.purpose: To complete the recovery action safely by moving only when the robot is ready for movement per the source rule.
steps.instruction: Once the robot meets the source-described movement readiness condition (indicator turns green as required), proceed with moving the robot as allowed by your site process.
steps.expected_result: The robot is physically moved only after it reaches the source-described green readiness state indicating brakes are no longer locked for movement.
steps.healthy_condition: Movement occurs after the readiness condition is met; no movement is attempted during the locked-brake period.
steps.failure_condition: Movement occurs before the readiness condition is met (brakes still locked).

actions.label: Physically move robot
actions.exact_action: Proceed with moving the robot as allowed by your site process (only after it turns green readiness).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you realize the robot was moved before it reached the source-described readiness condition, stop and escalate for further troubleshooting.

success_criteria: Robot is physically moved only after the source-described green readiness condition is met (specifically, waiting until it turns green when solid green and not on a label).
healthy_conditions: Robot indicator transitions through the restart-cycle states and reaches solid green, then turns green readiness for movement.
No physical movement occurs while brakes are locked.
failure_conditions: Robot is moved while brakes are still locked (e.g., before it turns green readiness).
Robot does not reach solid green/green as described.
escalation_guidance: If the indicator does not reach the source-described solid green/green readiness condition, escalate for further troubleshooting.

screens_or_images.description: Robot restart cycle and indicator color/state behavior (flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green) and the rule to wait until it turns green before moving due to brake lock.

missing_details: The source does not define the exact visual distinction between 'solid green' and 'turns green' beyond the wording; it is treated as an observable readiness transition.

The source does not provide specific escalation contacts or additional troubleshooting steps beyond 'escalate for further troubleshooting' when the indicator does not reach the described green condition.
